execution.reason: Static blockers found and upstream requested a corrected v2 before execution.

blockers.detail: EXPECTED_SUITES selects tests/a24_bootstrap_exclusion/test_integration.py for the seven-test group; the required group is tests/a24_controlled_capture/test_integration.py.
The test command does not call verify_package and does not verify --tree against effective-manifest.json, so a 21-test receipt can be produced from an unrelated or tampered tree.
verify_package checks root-manifest.json only when it exists; the handoff root membership contract is therefore optional to the bundled verifier.

safe_relative uses PurePosixPath then Windows Path without rejecting backslashes, drive/UNC forms, ADS colons, reserved device names, trailing dots/spaces, Unicode/case-fold collisions, or prefix conflicts.

MemoryPolicy blocks event-loop file descriptors and the runner patches selected socket/Popen/urlopen calls, but it does not confine filesystem reads/writes or cover every process/network entry point; historical authority files are present in baseline and are not denied by policy.
The receipt records only failure/error counts and discards test IDs and tracebacks, limiting independent diagnosis of a failed replay.

carry_forward: None. A changed v2 archive requires fresh byte identity, static review, extraction, reconstruction, tamper/overwrite negatives, and 21-test execution.
